# Fractional Head of AI / Fractional CAIO

> Part-time Head of AI or Chief AI Officer for one or more companies, usually on a monthly retainer.

| Family | Work footprint | Evidence status | GenAI target | CCI rank | Résumé variant |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent & Fractional | Leadership and independent practice (plane) | Verified (V) | L5 (leadership and independent tracks) | L5 of 5 (ranked separately) | — (no résumé variant: case studies and referrals instead) |

Evidence status follows the [catalog's classes](../role-catalog.md#12-status-classes-for-canonical-roles). The GenAI target order and the CCI rank answer different questions: the [target order](../genai-target-roles.md) is restricted to GenAI work; the [CCI rank](../role-rankings.md) scores the role as a whole career. The work footprint is judgement (Grade D) from the [role map](../role-map.md).

## The numbers

| Pillar | Score (0–10: mid, range) | Grade | Basis |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| Demand | 2.5 (1.5–3.5) | C | Go Fractional: CAIO 6 then 10 posts in 90 days (label 'falling sharply') vs 326 profiles; Fractional CTO 19 then 17 posts (labels 'rising sharply', then 'rising') vs 1,042-1,116 profiles [T0-18:52, 193-196]. T0-18 rates this demand evidence 'conflicting' [T0-18:1261]. |
| Pay | 4 (3–5.5) | C | Asks $150-250/hr; offers 0.59-0.91x asks; retainers ~$8-13K/month for 10-13 h/week; modelled US net P50 $105K, P90 $160K for practitioners with traction (model, D) [T0-18:82-89, 116]. Contract/hourly income maps to the 3-4 anchor. |
| Durability | 4.5 (3–6) | D | Judgement. UK GenAI contract median fell from GBP613-625 (2024) to GBP550 (2025-26); T0-18 models that a 30% cut in delivery hours needs a 43% higher hourly rate to hold revenue [T0-18:95, 119, 148]. |
| Leverage | 7 (6–8) | D | Judgement. |
| Access (experience gate) | 2 (1–3) | C | Fractional Jobs survey respondents (n=1,733, all functions, incl. past and aspiring fractionals): 87% have 11+ years; 83% Director-level or above [T0-18:1406]. |

Scores use the anchored rubric in [role-rankings §1](../role-rankings.md#1-method-composite-career-index-cci); the composite (CCI) is a model output (Grade M). The same inputs, with every source, are in [Appendix A](../role-rankings.md#appendix-a-scoring-inputs). Measured pay by title, city and level is in [pay benchmarks](../../09-compensation/pay-benchmarks.md).

## Who it suits

A leadership or independent track: people reach it after years of experience. When to target it: [GenAI target roles §8](../genai-target-roles.md#8-leadership-and-independent-tracks-when-to-target-them).

## What you need

- No skill inventory of its own: the catalog maps independent and fractional practice to the [leadership skill map](../../03-skills-and-tech/role-skill-maps.md#skills-leadership).

## How to prove it

- Case studies, client outcomes and referrals carry this track, not portfolio projects; see the [catalog profile](../role-catalog.md#profile-fractional-ai-leader).

## How you are interviewed

- No interview-track evidence in the corpus for this role. Practise with the closest track's [prep pack](../../08-interviewing/prep-packs.md) and the behavioural pack.
- Classify the loop first, then prepare by round: [interview loops](../../08-interviewing/interview-loops.md).

## Résumé

- Independent and fractional work runs on case studies and referrals rather than portal résumés, so it has no variant.
